commentary.bulkers: The Capesize "Springbank" 177/2010 New Times, China (SS 11/2025, DD 11/2023, BWTS fitted) was committed to Greek buyers Kassian Maritime for USD 26,5 mill. For reference, the one-year-younger "Lowlands Tenacity" 180/2011 HHIC, Philippines (SS 04/2026, DD 05/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold a week ago at USD 29,5 mill. Safe Bulkers sold their Panamax "Koulitsa" 76/2003 Oshima, Japan (SS/DD 04/2023, BWTS fitted) to UAE based buyers for USD 13,6 mill. For comparison, the two-years-younger "Atlantic Hero" 75/2005 Sanoyas, Japan (SS 06/2025, DD 08/2023) was sold a couple of weeks ago at USD 14,9 mill. Moreover, the "Imperial Rose" 76/2008 Shin Kasado, Japan (SS/DD 08/2023) of Golden Union Shipping was committed to Greek buyers for USD 18 mill, while the one-year-older "Canea" 75/2007 Universal, Japan (SS/DD 06/2022) from Spring Marine was committed to Greek buyers also for USD 17,5 mill. On the Supramax sector, Chellaram Shipping sold their "Darya Lakshmi" 55/2009 Mitsui, Japan (SS 07/2024, DD 10/2022) to Greek buyers for USD 16,5 mill, whilst the one-year-younger "YM Tradition" 55/2010 Kawasaki, Japan (SS 01/2025, DD 10/2022, BWTS fitted) from Yamamaru Kisen was sold for USD 16,3 mill basis delivery July-October of 2021. In addition, the "Imperial Fortune" 53/2006 Imabari, Japan (SS 10/2025, DD 10/2023, BWTS fitted) of Kenzan Kaiun was sold for USD 13,2 mill basis delivery September- October of 2021. Interlink Maritime have committed their Handysize sisters "Interlink Verity" & "Interlink Parity" 37/2012 Huatai, China (SS/DD 06/2022 & 03/2022 respectively) to Greek buyers Costamare for USD 14,75 mill each. Furthermore, Costamare is rumored to have acquired the similar "N Discovery" 37/2012 Zhejiang, China (SS/DD 10/2022) from Nord for low USD 14 mill and the Korean built "Cielo Di Capalbio" 36/2012 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS/DD 03/2022) from d'Amico for USD 16 mill.
commentary.tankers: Okeanis Eco Tankers sold their VLCCs "Nissos Antiparos" & "Nissos Santorini" 319/2019 Hyundai, Korea (SS 07/2024, DD 07/2022, BWTS & Scrubber fitted both) to Frontline for USD 90 mill each basis delivery in November of 2021. Meanwhile, Okeanis Eco Tankers acquired from Kyklades Maritime the resales "Nissos Kea" & "Nissos Nikouria" 299/2022 Hyundai, Korea (BWTS & Scrubber fitted) for USD 97 mill each basis delivery in 1st half of 2022. The MR2 "Jasmine Express" 47/2004 Onomichi, Japan (SS/DD 05/2022) was sold to Greek buyers for USD 7,6 mill. Remind you that back in May, the Korean built "Integrity" 46/2004 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 11/2024, DD 02/2023) was sold for USD 9 mill.
